title: NCAA: CSB's slim win over Lyceum creates 3-way tie on top of Group A
summary: College of Saint Benilde created a logjam at the top of Group A after beating Lyceum, 107-103, in the NCAA Season 102 men's basketball tournament on Friday at the San Andres Sports Complex.
